basis: On January 8, AXT narrowed expected company-wide revenue for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 to $22.5 million–$23.5 million. The high end was 6.39% below Q4 2024 consolidated revenue of $25,105,000 and $349,750 below the $23,849,750 cutoff. This was the earliest qualifying public disclosure found.

coverage.detail: July 31 Q2 earnings release reported results through June 30 and announced the public earnings call. It supplied no Q4 revenue ceiling.
On the July 31 call, management's $19 million–$21 million revenue outlook explicitly covered Q3 2025. The call supplied no comparable Q4 range.
The August 19 Regulation FD filing disclosed additional export permits for subsidiary Tongmei. It gave no consolidated Q4 revenue outlook.
The October 30 Q3 earnings release reported consolidated revenue of $27,955,000 for Q3 and $65,285,000 for the first nine months. The release supplied no numeric Q4 revenue ceiling.
At 17:11 on the October 30 public earnings call, management gave a Q4 revenue range of $27 million–$30 million, conditional on export permits. Even its low end exceeded the cutoff.
AXT's December 2 notice announced the December 16 Northland virtual conference and gave no forecast. A search for public AXT slides or remarks from the event found no Q4 revenue update.

AXT's December 29 share-offering prospectus said its only significant announcement during the period of increased November–December trading concerned the three and nine months ended September 30. The prospectus supplied no Q4 revenue range.

The January 8 issuer release gave the qualifying $22.5 million–$23.5 million Q4 range. AXT attributed the revision primarily to fewer indium phosphide export permits than expected. The January 14 Needham presentation followed this disclosure.

The February 19 actual-results release confirmed the decline. Its condensed consolidated statements of operations show December-quarter revenue of $23,041,000 for 2025 and $25,105,000 for 2024 on the same reported revenue line, an 8.22% decline.

publication_date_evidence: AXT's investor-relations release is dated January 8, 2026. Its Form 8-K, filed January 9, independently confirms in Item 2.02 that AXT issued the release on January 8. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000121390026002690/ea0272358-8k_axtinc.htm
